question: Test of the closing candidate in CAP-U9PREDICT2.json for difference 53, read after the predictions were pushed (929c357), and four edge cases of the outline fade. Blocks Probe.
count: 3 of 3 on where it closes, and closed for all 20 steps back in all 3 runs.

columns: unheld top, last open and first closed
close.note: Read in steps of 5. The closing point lies from -418 to -422. -421 is inferred: band high was read in each walk, not predicted, and the reason given for it, the top bar at 55, is an idea, not a read.

ours.close: Built, desktop only: ours closes when its own top without the hold passes -421, and stays closed. Ours gets that top from its own band, and 52 has no rule, so ours closes later: by this code at about 88 px at 477.8 tall, 54 at 623.7, 116 at 755.7 and 316 at 1417.5, worked out from the reads, not measured side by side. Phone not read: ours stays open there.

fade.straight to another section: Each section has its own outline. The old one fades out while the new one fades in, the same 0.2 s, in step. Ours left the old at once; built: a copy left behind fades out. Ours now reads the same series.
fade.back on during the fade: It runs back from where it is, in a time that shrinks to match: 0.945 back to 1 in about 35 ms, 0.498 back to 1 in about 100 ms: 0.53, 0.616, 0.75, 0.882, 0.973. Ours as it was: 0.53, 0.616, 0.75, 0.886, 0.973, no change needed.
fade.selecting a block in the hovered section: It stays lit. The read also has a blip: the press scrolled the block, so the pointer was briefly over the next section, and the fade began and ran back. Ours stays lit through its rebuild; no change needed. The blip in ours not compared.
fade.a gesture: Held: the outline fades over 0.2 s, not at once. Let go: it fades back in over 0.2 s. Ours went at once; built, by the same copy. The other parts still go at once in ours; their fade in a gesture is not read here. The copy does not follow a scroll during its 0.2 s, and the oracle's outline would, since it is in the frame.

pressed: Custom height by name, with the step's on-top check. The Add Block menu by name for a Button, then Escape. A Button block pressed and held by its middle, and let go at home. Pointer moves at set coordinates, which press nothing. Scrolling by script.
